title: Outcome of Surgery for Idiopathic Macular Holes
brief_summary: Retrospective medical chart review of patients undergoing surgical repair of idiopathic macular hole
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient suffering from primary idiopathic macular hole and treated by retinal repair surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Presence of other retinal disease
study_population: Patients treated by retinal repair surgery for idiopathic macular hole
